training_cohort.source: OpenML 45547 Cardiovascular Disease Cohort (physiologically cleaned & deduplicated)

intended_use: Clinician-in-the-loop cardiovascular risk triage and dual-level interpretability research prototype. Outputs calibrated risk, Mondrian conformal abstention, OOD safety alerts, biomarker attentions, matched cohort neighbors, and mutable-only recourse.
limitations: Trained on retrospective screening data; requires prospective hospital EHR validation before clinical use.
Not FDA-cleared or CE-marked medical software.
Automatically defers uncertain or out-of-distribution patients to clinician review.
